name: RealFi USDrf
oneLiner: USDrf is RealFi's Cardano dollar token backed by off-chain credit, with a Treasury liquidity buffer and institution-only direct redemption.
collateral: Off-chain Treasury bills, money market funds, floating-rate credit, CLO ETFs and private credit; published allocation ranges describe strategy rather than verified current holdings.
pegMechanism: Whitelisted institutions mint and redeem through a human-approved FIFO queue with daily and monthly limits. Retail exits depend on secondary markets. Protocol first-loss reserves and the junior sUSDrf tranche absorb losses before USDrf.

milestones.title: RealFi launches on Cardano mainnet
milestones.description: RealFi announced its Cardano mainnet launch with USDrf and the junior staked token sUSDrf.
